stock: 265/70R16 on 7.5Jx16 ET63 (OE on the 2001–2006 G 270 CDI; also the 500 GE's factory size)

wheel.offset: ET63 on most pre-2009 factory sizes; ET43 (G 550) and ET50 (G 63) on 2015 US trucks

max_tire.note: Fits unlifted G 500/G 550s on factory 18s per Expedition Portal owners; 285/65R18 rubs slightly at full left lock. One G 500 owner reports 315/75R16s with no lift, but 35s on stock springs usually rub somewhere.
JWO 2-in and Eurowise 60 mm springs are sold as 33-in setups; wheel offset +30 or lower (or a ~30 mm spacer) and longer shocks.
GwagenParts' ~75 mm front kit (2002–2018 G 500/G 55/G 550/G 63/G 65) claims room for 35s; spacers may be needed, caster bushings included.
JWO 4-in springs: offset +20 or lower (typically 50 mm spacers on stock wheels) and caster-correction bushings; adjustable panhard bars recommended.

items.title: Fuel return hose can crack and leak
items.summary: Hoses between the tank and return line could develop microcracks and leak fuel; dealers replace them.

items.title: Incorrect SCN software coding
items.summary: Wrong coding after a workshop visit could affect gauges, the check-engine light and the crash fuel-pump cutoff; dealers recode.

items.title: Fuel line quick connectors not fully seated
items.summary: Underbody fuel-line connectors may not have been fully connected on the assembly line.

items.title: Front turn signals behind grille cover
items.summary: Fails FMVSS 108 because the grille cover can reduce signal visibility; dealers fit improved turn-signal units.

items.title: Passenger airbag molding strip can come loose
items.summary: Built 20 September 2010–27 April 2011; part of the molding strip could become a projectile when the passenger airbag deploys.

items.title: Steering coupling may be under-tightened
items.summary: An insufficiently tightened steering coupling can wear the steering connection.

items.title: Inner door-release cable may break
items.summary: The cable can snap if the door is hard to open, such as after a crash.

items.title: ESP fault with Distronic Plus engaged
items.years: 2016–2017 G 550, G 63 AMG and G 65 AMG
items.summary: An ESP malfunction while Distronic Plus is on may stop the engine reducing power.

items.title: eCall date/time software fault
items.summary: The emergency-call system could send an inaccurate location because its clock is wrong.

identify.intro: Thirty years of W463 means four-cylinder diesels and V12 AMGs share one body, and badges, bumpers and flares swap in an afternoon. The VIN and data card are what count.

items.head: VIN
items.body: US trucks from 2002 start WDC: a G 500 decodes as WDCYR49E and a 2003 G 55 AMG as WDCYR46E. Position 10 is the model year and position 11 is X for Graz. European-format chassis numbers carry the model code, such as WDB463228 on 500 GEs.

items.head: Europa International trucks
items.body: Europa federalised W463s from 1993 and issued US VINs as a small-volume manufacturer; Mercedes-Benz USA took over for MY2002. One BaT-sold Europa G 500's VIN fails NHTSA's standard decode, so get the import paperwork.

items.head: Fake AMGs
items.body: Autocar warns about Gs converted to look like AMGs. Check that the VIN and factory data card agree with the badges.

items.head: Factory data card
items.body: Mercedes-Benz Classic sells a digital data card with original option codes, paint and trim for most cars built 1986–2010 (AMG models excluded), for €130 with proof of ownership.

items.head: Lockers and traction aids
items.body: Every W463 has three locks, engaged in order: centre, rear, front. Trucks from the 2001–02 update also have ESP, Brake Assist and 4ETS; earlier ones rely on the lockers alone.

values.intro: The W463 runs from $20k high-mile V8s to six-figure Cabriolets; the G 550s from the last few years and the rare bodies command the money.
values.note: Based on 180 sold Bring a Trailer auctions on the W463 (1991–2018) page from January 2025 to October 2026 (median $50,000). Low-mileage G 550s and Cabriolets set the top of the market. AMG trucks are listed on a separate BaT page and aren't included.

paragraphs: Mercedes-Benz USA didn't sell the W463 until the 2002 model year. Before that, Europa International of New Mexico federalised and sold them from 1993. Diesels, short-wheelbase trucks and most Cabriolets were never sold new in the US. NHTSA allows any vehicle at least 25 years old to be imported, counted from the date of manufacture, so those grey-market W463s built up to late 2001 are now eligible. Check state titling and emissions rules, particularly in California, before you commit.

production.intro: The W463 was built in Graz from 1990 to 2018, outliving the W460 it replaced by nearly three decades.
